tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Check that a record still says what was signed: the permitted or refused decision, unchanged, under a trusted or embedded key. Handles both formats: ATTESTATION-v1 (a model-call decision) and ACTION-v1 (an agent tool action). No Aqta service in the check.

tools.name: decode_receipt
tools.description: Read a receipt field by field, with stated limits. Does not check the signature.

tools.name: get_public_key
tools.description: Fetch the published Seal signing key.

tools.name: get_sample_receipt
tools.description: A genuine signed receipt from the sample workspace (demo key), for trying verification.

tools.name: get_review_pack
tools.description: The published sample evidence pack: fixed review question, bound receipts, disclosure.

tools.name: verify_evidence_pack
tools.description: Verify a review pack receipt by receipt. Each verdict comes from the signed envelope itself, never from stored state, and results are per-receipt, never an average.

tools.name: explain_attestation_format
tools.description: The receipt format: fields, outcomes, verification commands, and what a signature does not establish. Use before describing the format.

tools.name: list_my_receipts
tools.description: List your workspace receipts filtered by outcome, policy, model, or date range. Requires your aqta_ key as Bearer.

tools.name: get_transparency_proof
tools.description: Inclusion proof plus signed tree head for one of your receipts. Requires your aqta_ key.

tools.name: workspace_summary
tools.description: Outcome, model and policy counts across your recent receipts. Requires your aqta_ key.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_my_receipts" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List your workspace receipts filtered by outcome, policy, model, or date range. Requires your aqta_ key as Bearer.
